scope: Independent original-image review of exactly eight native E01/reference pairs (16 original images); terminal component and surrounding layout only.
method: Viewed every original actual JPEG and mapped reference PNG with view_image(detail=original), in paired order. Independently verified all24 image/reference/AX hashes and image dimensions. Read terminal AX fields and capture metadata corrections. No GUI, source mutation, build, test, renderer recreation or screenshot modification.

primarySelection.mist: E01-mist-clean.jpg (owner recapture after closing unrelated F14 error); original E01-mist remains preserved as supplementary and is not one of the16 reviewed primary originals.

sourceDiagnosisBoundary.confirmed: Native evidence shows stale-looking terminal colors after same-PTY hidden/layout/theme cycles. Existing TerminalView mutates xterm options from a documentElement observer, while its visible fit path does not reread theme.
sourceDiagnosisBoundary.correctedInference: applyAppearance does write document.documentElement, so a wrong observed DOM node is not established as root cause. Hidden-node/theme timing remains inference, not confirmed diagnosis.
sourceDiagnosisBoundary.proposedMinimalFollowup: Root requested independent theme-visible patch: sync theme inside sendResize after positive dimensions and before fit; no remount/restart. Component harness and actual samePTY dark→light→dark reopen must verify live and closed history.
